introduction: Vermont 211 connects residents with community resources for food, shelter, transport and other needs. Current live referral hours are 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.
description: Vermont 211 connects residents with community resources for food, shelter, transport and other needs. Current live referral hours are 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.

sections.who: People seeking local resources can use the free, confidential service. Referred organizations make their own eligibility decisions.
sections.get: You receive resource information and provider contacts. Vermont 211 no longer issues after-hours General Assistance emergency-housing intake or vouchers.

sections.apply:
1. Request referrals

    Call 211, text your ZIP code to 898211 or search Vermont 211.

  2. Use the correct housing route

    The provider directs GA emergency-housing eligibility to ESD at 800-775-0506 during its published weekday hours.

  3. Check providers

    Ask referred services about availability and intake.
sections.after: If one referral cannot help, ask for another. Check current hours before relying on after-hours assistance.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Vermont 211 current service notice. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is live 211 service around the clock?
The current provider page lists 8 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.
Can 211 issue after-hours GA housing vouchers?
The provider says that role ended September 1.
Vermont 211 describes its information service as free.
No. Contact the provider to confirm.
